q1.question: What is AEDST?
q1.answer: AEDST is a task app for planning, tracking and finishing work. It is fast, accessible and keeps working without an internet connection.

q2.question: Does it work offline?
q2.answer: Yes. You can create and edit tasks offline. Changes are saved on your device and sent automatically once you reconnect.

q3.question: Which languages are supported?
q3.answer: English, Russian, Tajik, Uzbek and Arabic. Arabic uses a full right-to-left layout.

q4.question: Is there a free plan?
q4.answer: A free plan is planned. Pricing shown on this page is a placeholder and will be confirmed before launch.

q5.question: How is my data protected?
q5.answer: Sign-in sessions are kept in secure cookies that page scripts cannot read, and analytics only run after you consent. See the privacy policy for details.
